Marlow & Vance

THE STUDIO IS OPEN. A practice of eleven people working on typography, identity and the slower kinds of editorial design.

We began in a single room above a bookbinder in 2009 and have kept the shop deliberately small since. The work is better when the people who sold it are the people who make it.

Selected work

Wayfinding for the Lowlands Museum, a twelve-year identity programme for Harrow Press, and the reissue of the Coleridge letters in three volumes.

We publish a short letter four times a year about what we have been reading. It is not a newsletter about us.

Contact

Correspondence is welcome at the Chandlery, Bristol.
